n, k = map(int, input().split())
digits = []
while n > 0:
    digits.append(n % k)
    n //= k

size = len(digits)
MOD = 1000000007

# Initialize the base matrix
matrix = [[0] * (k + 1) for _ in range(k + 1)]
for j in range(k + 1):
    matrix[0][j] = 1
    matrix[j][j] = 1

# Precompute powers of the matrix
power_matrices = [matrix]
for i in range(1, size):
    prev = power_matrices[i - 1]
    now = [[0] * (k + 1) for _ in range(k + 1)]
    for x in range(k + 1):
        for y in range(k + 1):
            for z in range(k + 1):
                now[x][z] = (now[x][z] + prev[x][y] * matrix[y][z]) % MOD
    power_matrices.append(now)

result = 1
add = 0
for i in range(size - 1, -1, -1):
    for j in range(digits[i]):
        for x in range(k + 1):
            result = (result * power_matrices[i][(x + add) % k][k]) % MOD
        add = (add + j) % k

print(result % MOD)
</translated_code>
